import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    cols = ["user_id", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]

    if events.empty:
        return {"user_sessions": pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)}

    events = events.sort_values(
        ["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    prev_ts = events.groupby("user_id")["event_ts"].shift(1)
    gap = events["event_ts"] - prev_ts

    new_sess = (prev_ts.isna() | (gap > pd.Timedelta(minutes=30))).astype(int)

    session_num = new_sess.groupby(events["user_id"]).cumsum()

    events["session_num"] = session_num

    grouped = events.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"], as_index=False).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    )

    grouped = grouped.sort_values(["user_id", "session_num"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    result = grouped[cols]

    return {"user_sessions": result}
